elements.name: Inspect Sketch commands outside sketch edit

steps.name: a part containing an existing sketch is active in the MCAD Software
sketch edit is inactive
the user selects the Sketch ribbon tab
Line, Circle, Arc, Rectangle, Fillet, Text and Point are enabled in Create
Project Geometry is disabled
the commands in Modify, Pattern, Constrain, Insert and Format are disabled
the active part and model browser remain visible

elements.name: Revisit Sketch from another ribbon tab

steps.name: a part containing an existing sketch is active in the MCAD Software
sketch edit is inactive
the Sketch ribbon tab is selected
the user selects the 3D Model ribbon tab
the user selects the Sketch ribbon tab again
Line, Circle, Arc, Rectangle, Fillet, Text and Point remain enabled in Create
Project Geometry remains disabled
the commands in Modify, Pattern, Constrain, Insert and Format remain disabled
the active part and model browser remain visible

elements.name: Inspect Sketch ribbon while editing an existing sketch

steps.name: a part containing an existing sketch is active in the MCAD Software
sketch edit is inactive
the user opens the existing sketch from the model browser
the Sketch ribbon tab is selected
the 2D sketch workspace shows the existing profile
Create, Modify, Pattern, Constrain, Insert and Format groups are displayed
Finish is available to exit sketch editing
the user selects Line
the Line command prompt requests a start point
the Line tooltip indicates line and arc creation
the user exits sketch editing with Finish
the previous part workspace and ribbon context return
the existing sketch remains in the model browser
